descriptionChirho: Freedom or release from bondage, especially in the context of the Jubilee year and Jeremiah's covenant of liberation for Hebrew slaves. The term carries a legal-cultic sense of proclaimed emancipation. Eng 'liberty / the liberty', spa 'libertad / la libertad', hin 'svatantrata / chutkare', arb 'hurriyyah / al-hurriyyah', kor 'jayu / huinyeon', swa 'uhuru'.

An adjective describing myrrh that flows freely, i.e., the finest grade of liquid myrrh that drips naturally without pressing, used in Exodus 30:23 for the holy anointing oil recipe. This sense is distinct from the 'liberty' meaning. Eng 'flowing', spa 'libertad' (mistranslated), hin 'shuddh' (pure), arb 'hurr' (free-flowing), kor 'jayuropge heureunun' (freely flowing), swa 'safi' (pure/clean).
